reviews.title: Top Tier App but More Customization Needed
reviews.text: I love this app, especially since I can use all of its features without being forced into a subscription, which has been amazing for keeping me on track with my goals. My only complaint is the lack of customization when creating a custom challenge, for example the colors, icons, and task arrangement. Specifically there is no way to reorder items on your checklist inside a custom challenge. Adding a drag and drop or sorting option would allow me to arrange my tasks chronologically from morning to night, making checking them off feel so much more natural throughout the day. Other than that it’s great!

reviews.title: Expected more. Somewhat glitchy.
reviews.text:
I expected a little more out of the paid version of this app. I’m now on day 21 and know it pretty well. First, the day number constantly glitches to day 1 on both the widget and in the app. That’s probably my biggest pet peeve. 

Second, I really thought when I bought the pro version, I’d get more widget options. One thing I don’t like is after completing the day in the widget, it only gives options to share to social media. I don’t want to share each completed day. It’d be nice to customize that to just say congrats or whatever. 

I think the main thing the pro version got me was to be able to store the progress photo in app? Not worth it imo.

reviews.title: Shady Business Practices
reviews.text:
I bought one of the “plans” from this company that ignored every answer I gave and provided an AI generated plan that was BS. The app doesn’t match the “plans” at all and there is no way to connect the two. Every attempt at logging into the app doesn’t work - as soon as I click on another screen then go back to account, I’m prompted to log in again. When it “does” log in, nothing changes and the cycle continues.
Subscriptions also don’t appear in your apple subscription manager. I never signed up for a subscription - only bought the initial plan 4 months ago - and suddenly I’m subscribed for $80 a month requiring me to search all over their website to cancel it. With no proof of ever signing up or canceling it.
75 Hard and 75 Soft are usually fun challenges. Don’t waste the time and money with this program though, unless you enjoy getting scammed in this economy.
